title: CheckResult
description: What the model must return for one seat check. Validate every response against this before writing to the database; reject and retry once on failure.

found_name.description: CURRENT holder (repeat the listed person if confirmed). null if unknown.

found_email.description: Only an address seen verbatim on a fetched page. Never a guess.

found_email_is_generic.description: true for office mailboxes like purchasing@, procurement@, info@

source_url.description: Single best page that supports the finding.

evidence_date.description: ISO date the source states (publication, meeting, release). null if the page is undated.

confidence.description: High requires a dated (2025 or later) official source. Undated live official page = Medium at most.

unresolved_reason.description: Required when status is unable_to_confirm or unclear; otherwise null.

notes.description: 1-2 sentences: evidence and its date, caveats. Put any inferred email here prefixed 'Pattern guess (UNVERIFIED):'. No allegations, arrests, or personal matters.
